MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing and electrical tape fit naturally with my wire connectors because they would help insulate and protect electrical repair connections.",
    "The mounting tape connects with my past use of repair adhesives, although I would wait for a specific mounting job before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Reflective tape serves a different purpose from the fastening and repair tapes I have bought; sharing the word tape does not make it useful for my current needs.",
    "Deck screws, a feeler gauge, and a step drill bit require particular projects I do not currently have. General usefulness for repairs is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "The rapid test, examination gloves, and pH meter do not address a need suggested by my repair purchases, and the gloves also leave me uncertain about fit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of repair supplies seem to have been taken as interest in almost any tool or maintenance item.",
    "My tape purchases seem to have been treated as interchangeable, even though fastening, electrical insulation, reflective marking, and mounting solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Supplies that complement something I already use, such as insulation for my wire connectors, give me a clearer reason to choose an item.",
    "I buy moderately and need a concrete task to justify most purchases; an item can fit my interests without being something I would choose now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often missed the specific purpose and immediate need that make a supply worth choosing."
}
